product.title: Doubtful Sound Wilderness Cruise from Queenstown

description.text: In Queenstown, this full-day wilderness outing leaves Beach Street for Lake Manapouri, Wilmot Pass, Deep Cove, and a catamaran cruise on Doubtful Sound. The published format is a remote fiord day rather than a Milford Sound coach cruise. The format suits visitors who want a quieter sound without a scenic flight. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Queenstown, and the itinerary stays on Manapouri, Wilmot Pass, and Doubtful Sound that define this outing rather than a Mitre Peak fly-cruise.

end.description: Return to the Queenstown meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
